name: TagFilter
summary: Filter a list by tag: a group of toggle buttons, or links to filtered pages that work without script.

guidance.useFor: Narrowing a list of projects or posts by discipline or topic.
insteadUse: One choice that replaces the view: Segmented control or Tabs
Many filters at once: a form with Checkboxes and a submit button
content: Name the group by what it filters: "Filter projects"
Say how many items now show, in a status message, after each change

rungReason: Buttons with aria-pressed (data-lue-toggle on the HTML path) or links with aria-current; the group is role="group" or a <nav>.

attributes.aria-current: page, on the filter being shown

a11y.role: group of toggle buttons, or navigation of links
a11y.name: aria-label

states.via: [aria-pressed="true"] on a button, [aria-current="page"] on a link

keyboard.action: Turns the focused tag on or off
Turns the focused tag on or off, or follows its link

props.label: what it filters
props.options: { value, label, href? }[]; every href → links

rules: Without script, use the links form: each tag is a link to the filtered page
Filtering doesn't move focus; announce the new count in a status message (WCAG 4.1.3)
The chosen state is said in words (aria-pressed, aria-current) and drawn as the raised key
withoutJavaScript: The links form works fully; the buttons form needs data-lue-toggle (from @lue-ui/elements) or a framework
forcedColors: As Button: the chosen tag is SelectedItem
